meta.title: Network and mentors
meta.description: Organisations behind the innovations in the Library, the Hub's mentors and experts, partnerships, open grant calls and notifications.

title: Network and mentors
lead: Who in Małopolska creates social innovations, who you can ask for advice, who you could partner with, and which grant calls are open now. Sign up and we'll let you know about new grant calls and solutions.

calls.heading: Open grant calls
calls.dates: {range, select, both {from {from} to {to}} to {until {to}} other {dates are on the grant call page}}
calls.demoAction: Submit an idea and prepare an application
calls.emptyTitle: No grant call is open right now
calls.emptyBody: Sign up below — we'll let you know when a new one opens.

ask.heading: Ask an expert
ask.lead: Do you have a question about a service, a project or a grant call? The ROPS team will pass it on to an expert in the right area.

question.title: What is your question?
question.hint: Write it the way you would say it on the phone. Please don't give names or addresses.
question.label: Your question
question.example: For example: “How can a municipality organise respite care for carers?”
question.error: Please write your question in at least one sentence.

area.title: Which area is it about?
area.hint: This helps us choose the right expert.
area.error: Choose an area, or “I don't know / other”.

contact.title: How should we reply?
contact.hint: You can always see the reply with your case code.

case.who: Asked by: {role}{onBehalf, select, yes { (on behalf of another person or group)} other {}}

people.heading: Mentors and experts
people.sample: In this prototype we show sample people — this is not real data. In the full service, mentors and experts who work with ROPS will be listed here.
people.emptyTitle: The list of mentors is being prepared
people.emptyBody: You can ask your question now — the ROPS team will find an expert.

orgs.heading: Organisations that create innovations
orgs.lead: {count, plural, one {# organisation} other {# organisations}} from the cards of the Social Innovation Library — the authors of solutions tested in Małopolska's incubators. We don't list private individuals.
orgs.connectLead: Would you like to work with one of them? Choose “Connect me with this organisation”. ROPS arranges the contact — we don't show anyone's contact details.
orgs.source: Social Innovation Library, ROPS Kraków (the „Autorzy” section)

partner.heading: Find a partner
partner.lead: Looking for a partner for a joint project or service — a municipality, an organisation, a school or a social enterprise? Answer five short questions.
partner.broker: ROPS arranges the contact: it reads your request, gets in touch with the other side and replies in your case thread. We don't show anyone's contact details.

who.title: Who do you represent?
who.hint: Choose what best describes your institution.
who.error: Please choose the type of institution.

gmina.title: Where do you work?
gmina.hint: This helps us find a partner near you. You can skip this step.
gmina.label: Your municipality

offer.title: What can you offer?
offer.hint: For example: premises, volunteers, experience with a similar service, transport, your team's time.
offer.label: What you offer
offer.error: Please write a few words about what you can offer.

need.title: Who or what are you looking for?
need.hint: For example: a school for joint activities, an organisation that runs a similar service, a municipality for a pilot.
need.label: What you are looking for
need.error: Please write a few words about what you are looking for.
need.orgHint: If you'd like to connect with someone in particular, enter their name.

contact.title: How should we reply?
contact.hint: You can always see the reply on your case page, with your code.

case.intro: Looking for a partner — a request for ROPS to arrange the contact.

subscribe.heading: Notifications
subscribe.lead: We'll let you know when ROPS announces a grant call or when a new solution in your area appears in the Library.
subscribe.languageNote: For now, notifications are sent in Polish only.
subscribe.topic: What should we notify you about?
subscribe.callsHint: ROPS grants and programmes, as soon as they open.
subscribe.area: New solutions in a chosen area
subscribe.areaHint: When a new solution appears in the Library.
subscribe.smsHint: In this prototype text messages are only simulated.
subscribe.contactHint: We encrypt it. The system shows only a shortened form, e.g. j***@g***.pl.
subscribe.done: Done. We'll let you know about {what, select, calls {new grant calls} other {new solutions in the area “{area}”}}: {contact}.
subscribe.already: This contact ({contact}) is already signed up for notifications about {what, select, calls {new grant calls} other {new solutions in the area “{area}”}}.

errors.gminaInPowiat: Please choose a municipality in the selected county, or clear the county.

errors.offline: No connection to the server. Please check your internet and try again — your answers are still in the form.
